ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and identify potential patterns and connections between entities
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What are the most common schemes used to commit Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and identify areas for improvement in Medicaid oversight. I will analyze data and public records to identify patterns and connections between entities.
